2609.26347.title: TransBERT: A Framework for Synthetic Translation in Domain-Specific Language Modeling
2609.26347.paper_summary: The scarcity of non-English language data in specialized domains significantly limits the development of effective Natural Language Processing (NLP) tools. We present TransBERT, a novel framework for pre-training language models using exclusively synthetically translated text, and introduce TransCorpus, a scalable translation toolkit. Focusing on the life sciences domain in French, our approach demonstrates that state-of-the-art performance on various downstream tasks can be achieved solely by leveraging synthetically translated data. We release the TransCorpus toolkit, the TransCorpus-bio-fr corpus (36.4GB of French life sciences text), TransBERT-bio-fr, its associated pre-trained language model and reproducible code for both pre-training and fine-tuning. Our results highlight the viability of synthetic translation in a high-resource translation direction for building high-quality NLP resources in low-resource language/domain pairs.
2609.26347.paper_summary_zh: 非英語語言數據在專業領域的稀缺性顯著限制了有效的自然語言處理（NLP）工具的發展。<lb/>我們提出了TransBERT，一種專門使用合成翻譯文本進行預訓練語言模型的新框架，並介紹了TransCorpus，一個可擴展的翻譯工具包。<lb/>專注於法語生命科學領域，我們的方法展示了僅通過利用合成翻譯數據即可實現各種下游任務的最先進性能。<lb/>我們發布了TransCorpus工具包，TransCorpus-bio-fr語料庫（36.4GB的法語生命科學文本），TransBERT-bio-fr及其相關的預訓練語言模型和可重現的預訓練及微調代碼。<lb/>我們的結果突顯了在高資源翻譯方向中合成翻譯的可行性，以便在低資源語言/領域對中構建高質量的NLP資源。
